description: Defines classes and structures related to the uplink plane handling in a Radio Unit, including notification interfaces and request handlers for PRACH windows and uplink slots.

classes.name: ru_uplink_plane_rx_symbol_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying the completion of uplink symbols and PRACH windows.

classes.name: ru_uplink_plane_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling PRACH occasions and uplink slot processing requests.

methods.name: on_new_uplink_symbol
methods.description: Notifies the completion of an uplink symbol with context, resource grid, and validity status.

methods.name: on_new_prach_window_data
methods.description: Notifies that a PRACH window has been written in the buffer.

methods.name: handle_prach_occasion
methods.description: Requests capturing a PRACH window starting at specified slot and symbol.

methods.name: handle_new_uplink_slot
methods.description: Requests processing of a new uplink slot.
